question: Which goddesses protect the feet and all limbs of the body?
premises: Mahāmāyā is assigned to the pair of feet
Kuleśvarī is assigned to all limbs
Protection covers specific and total body parts
inference: Mahāmāyā protects the feet and Kuleśvarī protects all limbs.
plain_english: May Mahāmāyā protect my pair of feet, and may Kuleśvarī protect all my limbs.
